Hi mixers! I have a question for non-Israelis who have a child from a previous marriage. My situation is as follows: 
I have full custody of my son. According to Romanian law, I can make all decisions regarding my child without his father's approval, including relocating with him anywhere in the world. This is explicitly stated in the custody decision; I only need his approval in case of adoption.Although I have full decision-making rights over my son, I still had a notary document drawn up in which my ex-husband agrees to the boy's relocation to Israel. However, MH is now asking for another letter specifying that he also agrees to the minor becoming an Israeli citizen, not just relocating here with me. The father already signed that document too, but of course, I need to bring the original.We had our first A5 interview on August 16th. They gave me a new B1 visa until they confirm the A5, but my son is currently without a visa.
 Today we received an email, from which I understand that I was granted the A5, but my son was not. Now I wonder what is the meeting for in December. Maybe the "up-grade" that they refer to is the B1 that I got in August and  we'll have another interview for A5?🤔 
 My main question is: 
Isn't the full custody decision from the Romanian court enough? Why are they asking for this extra agreement from my ex?
